scripts.dev: npm run build -w @eduitsm/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @eduitsm/api" "npm run dev -w @eduitsm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eduitsm/shared && npm run build -w @eduitsm/api && npm run build -w @eduitsm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @eduitsm/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @eduitsm/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
